_comment: Wording the coverage evaluation uses to probe each category. {name} is the category's own name. A tenant may supply its own file for another language or vocabulary; nothing here is a business fact.
hazards: there is a gas leak near the {name}
there is water near the power points by the {name}
technical: is the {name} suitable for a load bearing wall

evidence.template: what is the warranty on the {name}
how do i clean and care for the {name}

hazardWithoutProduct: water is leaking near the power points
i can smell gas in the kitchen
there is smoke coming from the heater
hazardWithOperational: where is my order? my appliance is sparking
track my order, there is a gas leak in my kitchen
unknownTechnical: is the flux capacitor rated for a load bearing span
will this meet the building code for a six storey structure
operational: i want to return my purchase

_internalVocabulary_comment: Words and shapes that describe how the platform works. They must never appear in wording shown to a customer.
